## 04e2ffe8dc8e

**Reproduced lesson-identifiability defect inside the default generator domain.** The intended rule recolors the smallest green object magenta. Because non-green decoys are probabilistic, easy seed `0`, consecutive sample indices `0,1,2` contain no decoy, while index `3` does. Thus the rival “recolor the globally smallest nonzero object magenta” fits all three demonstrations but predicts a different query output.

All four exact grids pass `self_check` and were generated with no overrides, so this belongs to the documented default domain. The supported Racket run executed rule hash `c67640298f12`; `rival_fits_demo` is `[true,true,true]` and `rival_changes_query` is true in `checks/audit/04e2ffe8dc8e/audit.json`. The complete generated lesson/replay is `checks/audit/04e2ffe8dc8e/lesson.json`, and all four Racket outputs plus hashes are in `checks/audit/04e2ffe8dc8e/lesson-racket.json`. The selected generator hash was `21425260e0af633b53e19f217a8e6ba3f5959fa48b77b62a1356156ad465a165`.

A source-bound schedule should guarantee at least one non-green component smaller than the smallest green component in every three-demo window, and should declare the global-smallest rival executable. No audit-target file was changed.

Reproduction command from the packet root:

```sh
python3 run_with_racket.py python3 -m arcpuzzles apply 04e2ffe8dc8e \
  --input ../checks/audit/04e2ffe8dc8e/inputs.json \
  --out ../checks/audit/04e2ffe8dc8e/lesson-racket.json
```

## 04e2ffe8dc8e

**Reproduced shortcut-teaching defect.** The documented `texture="decoy"` control is intended to place an even-smaller non-green component so that “recolor the smallest object of any color” is refuted. With `seed=0`, `sample_index=0`, `texture="decoy"`, and `small_size=1`, the generator produces no non-green foreground cell because the decoy branch only runs when `small_size == 2`. The input passes the task's final `self_check`, belongs to the advertised override domain, and the canonical Racket output is exactly equal to the rival that recolors the smallest non-background component. Evidence: `checks/audit/04e2ffe8dc8e/case.json`, `input.json`, `racket.json`, and `rival-smallest-any-color.json`.

The audit linter additionally reproduced three contract failures: missing `RULE_HASH`, duplicate top-level `self_check`, and an unprobeable `small_size` declaration. The override stage stopped before its Cartesian matrix because unknown keys are silently accepted, `small_size` cannot be probed, and exact `n_large` has no `observe_overrides` witness. Evidence: `checks/audit-04-lint/` and `checks/audit-04-override/`.

Classification: **reproduced defect and shortcut**. I did not modify this audit target. I checked the generator source, canonical task description/rule binding, lint, override contract, generated witness, validator result, canonical Racket output, and one executable rival. I did not establish a defect in the Racket transformation itself.

## 04e2ffe8dc8e

**Issue found: `EXAMPLES_NEEDED = 3` is not backed by a curriculum guarantee, so
three demonstrations can all preserve the canonical ambiguity “recolor the
smallest object of any color.”** That rival fits all 3/3 canonical pairs because
they contain only green non-background objects.

An exact generated sequence uses seed `0`, difficulty `medium`: sample indices
`0`, `1`, and `2` contain no non-green decoy, and the rival matches the intended
output on all three. Sample index `3` is a valid generated query with a color-4
singleton, green component sizes `2,4,4`, and this disagreement:

```text
input        Racket authority   any-color rival
0000000000   0000000000         0000000000
0004000000   0004000000         0006000000
0000000300   0000000300         0000000300
0000000300   0000000300         0000000300
0000000330   0000000330         0000000330
0000000000   0000000000         0000000000
0000000000   0000000000         0000000000
0000000000   0000000000         0000000000
0000033000   0000033000         0000033000
0000033033   0000033066         0000033033
0000000000   0000000000         0000000000
```

The authority recolors the smallest **green** pair; the rival recolors the
smaller color-4 singleton. A 200-draw census per band produced an actual decoy
in only 40/200 cases. Moreover, the explicit override
`texture="decoy", small_size=1` silently produces no non-green decoy at all.
Add a scheduled real-decoy witness plus executable rival/lesson checks; merely
naming the texture `decoy` is insufficient. Evidence:
`checks/audits/adversarial_probe.json`.

## 04e2ffe8dc8e

**Classification: reproduced teaching shortcut, plus structural lint defects. Target source was not modified.**

Audited generator SHA-256: `21425260e0af633b53e19f217a8e6ba3f5959fa48b77b62a1356156ad465a165`; exact executed canonical Racket hash: `c67640298f12`.

The source-bound probe defines the plausible rival “recolor the globally smallest same-color 4-connected non-background object magenta.” Exact Racket execution reproduced two failures:

- Explicit `texture='decoy', small_size=1` produces no non-green decoy cells, passes `self_check`, and makes the rival output exactly equal to authority.
- The default medium sequence at seed 0, sample indices 0–2, gives three demonstrations all fit by the rival; sample index 3 is a query on which the rival differs by three cells. Thus a conventional three-demo/one-query lesson teaches an underdetermined rule even though every label is individually correct.

Complete input grids, authority/rival outputs, hashes, and disagreement counts are in `checks/audit/04e2ffe8dc8e/{case,inputs,racket,probe}.json`; the executable generation/comparison tools are beside them.

The isolated lint audit failed for three structural reasons: missing `RULE_HASH`, an unprobeable `small_size` choice axis, and two top-level `self_check` definitions. Evidence: `checks/audit/04e2ffe8dc8e-lint/checks/04e2ffe8dc8e_audit_lint.log`.

The separate override-stage attempt was interrupted by signal 15 and produced no completed verdict; this is retained honestly at `checks/audit/04e2ffe8dc8e-override/result.json` and is not used as support for the teaching finding.

**Suggested repair direction.** Add a deterministic demonstration that distinguishes green-qualified selection from the smallest-object-any-color rival, make `small_size` observably probeable, collapse to one authoritative `self_check`, and pin the verified canonical hash. A lesson-level rival gate should reject the retained three-demo window before training export.

## 04e2ffe8dc8e

**Classification: reproduced teaching shortcut and exact-control mismatch. Audit-only; source unchanged.**

Audited `repo/generators/04e2ffe8dc8e/generator.py` SHA-256: `21425260e0af633b53e19f217a8e6ba3f5959fa48b77b62a1356156ad465a165`, exactly the drawn audit source. The supported reference command executed canonical Racket rule `c67640298f12`; its rule hash matches the catalog.

**A1-04-TEACHING — four demonstrations still permit the wrong color-selection rule.** Generate with seed **3**, difficulty **medium**, no overrides, and consecutive sample indices **0–4**. The first four inputs contain only green foreground components. The plausible rival “recolor the globally smallest same-color, four-connected non-background component magenta” therefore fits all **4/4 actual Racket demonstration outputs**. The fifth input contains a smaller color-2 singleton at `(3,1)` and a smallest-green pair at `(3,8),(3,9)`. Actual Racket preserves the singleton and recolors the green pair; the rival does the reverse, disagreeing at exactly **three cells**. Coordinates are zero-based. All five inputs pass the target's final `self_check` and were generated inside its ordinary domain.

This independently reproduces the current review index's unresolved lesson-identifiability concern and extends its tested scope from three to **four consecutive demonstrations**. It does not establish how often the defect occurs. Individually correct labels do not ensure the demonstrations distinguish green-qualified selection from global size selection.

**A1-04-DECOY — an advertised decoy can contain no decoy.** Seed **0**, index **0**, medium, with `texture="decoy", small_size=1` passes `self_check` yet contains **zero non-green foreground cells**. Its actual Racket output equals the global-smallest rival. The source adds a decoy only when `small_size == 2`; the advertised joint request is neither fulfilled nor rejected as incompatible. This freshly confirms the existing source-bound override finding.

**Suggested repair direction:** guarantee an actual smaller non-green witness in each supported demonstration window and retain an executable global-smallest rival/lesson check. Treat `decoy` with `small_size=1` as an explicit incompatibility or revise the supported contract; silently omitting the promised decoy does not teach the color restriction. No repair, approval, or audit-resolution change was made here.

**Reproduction and scope.** The bounded search stopped at seed 3 after four seeds; only six saved inputs were sent to Racket. `checks/audit/04e2ffe8dc8e/probe.py` reproduces generation and the independent rival comparison. `generation.json` and `inputs.json` retain seeds, indices, overrides, grids and validator results. `racket.json` contains actual reference outputs, rule/source bindings and per-grid hashes. `finding.json` combines each input with authority/rival outputs and disagreement coordinates. `commands.json` records all three exact commands, cwd/environment, exit codes and output paths; each exited **0**. `manifest.json` hashes the evidence files.

From the outer extraction folder, the reference execution was:

```sh
/dev/shm/arc_review_071004/extracted/WORK/.venv/bin/python review.py run /dev/shm/arc_review_071004/extracted/WORK/.venv/bin/python -m arcpuzzles apply 04e2ffe8dc8e --input ../checks/audit/04e2ffe8dc8e/inputs.json --out ../checks/audit/04e2ffe8dc8e/racket.json
```

The recorded command uses the absolute interpreter path on both occurrences; use that exact argv from `commands.json` for replay because `review.py run` changes the payload cwd to `WORK/repo`. Checked scope: selected current source, notes, existing source-bound audit status, canonical rule/examples, six generated grids, final validator, actual Racket labels and one rival. No lint/battery rerun, corpus census, proof over all lessons, or defect in the Racket transformation is claimed. Missing `RULE_HASH` and duplicate validators were observed in source but were not independently re-linted in this audit.
